Monday.com has completely streamlined our Project Management process!

reviews.title: Solid, Versatile Project Management
reviews.pros: Monday.com is a powerful, table-based organizational tool. The intuitive interface looks like a spreadsheet. That simplicity is welcoming, but belies all of the functionality you get. Monday includes a number of functional templates that serve as a great starting point for things like project management, schedule tracking, and collaboration. You can track basically any type of work with it. I use it for project management and content creation scheduling and tracking. The templates got me up and running quickly, the tool is built for collaborating with colleagues on your projects, and there are integrations with dozens of other online tools and services. The calendar integration in particular helps me share information on projects beyond my team.
reviews.cons: The biggest con is probably the pricing model. Overall, it's a fair price for online subscription software, but as you increase users, the cost scales up quickly. Also, the interface can be a little slow switching from board to board - and if you're using it effectively,  you'll have lots of boards for different projects. This happens with a lot of cloud-based software, but I hope they can make it a little more responsive.
reviews.overall: A lot of people would describe  Monday.com as "a spreadsheet on steroids," and that's not totally wrong. A lot of what you can do here can be done in a spreadsheet.
